_comment: SELF-CONSISTENT SMOKE TEST ONLY. The expectedName values here reflect what the live free databases actually return for these barcodes, so the harness verifies the pipeline end-to-end. This is NOT a real accuracy benchmark — that requires a 500-item set where expectedName is INDEPENDENT ground truth from your own grocery receipts. Items with kind:produce are PLU-coded fresh items with no real barcode; they must route to manual entry and are excluded from the barcode metrics. Lesson from the first run: pairing a guessed barcode with a guessed name produces nonsense (a 'corn flakes' UPC turned out to be a car part) — which is exactly why the real set must come from receipts you actually scanned.

items.note: expected to MISS in the free DBs — illustrates the long tail tier-3 data or community contributions cover
